title: Infrastructure failures across 1,728 pipelines

display_labels.caveat: No confirmed infrastructure failure does not mean the pipeline passed.

creation_window.selection: Frozen pipeline creation-time window; outcomes observed during collection, not an as-of reconstruction
creation_window.boundary: API inclusive bounds, verified against retained window.json and audit.py; timestamps are not midnight

deduplication: Union of pipeline IDs with at least one confirmed infrastructure-failed attempt, including retries, recovered and mixed-failure runs; all recorded statuses
interpretation: Infrastructure involvement, not sole cause or a guarantee of green pipelines after mitigation; historical lower bound, not current reliability
status_snapshot: Original collection; status alone does not establish retry recovery

confirmed_selection.additional_evidence: Exact job-ID union from deep-audit/confirmed-additions.json, joined to failure-evidence.json with matching pipeline IDs

excluded_from_automatic_infra_classifica: database availability symptoms without established platform trigger

displayed_failure_types.counting_rule: Distinct pipeline-ID union within each displayed type, verified against pipeline-evidence.csv and confirmed-classes.csv; types overlap and are not additive

rows.label: Runner evictions (memory pressure or platform rules)

evidence_columns.pipeline_id: One row per distinct confirmed-affected pipeline
evidence_columns.pipeline_url: Canonical public project pipeline URL, checked against retained metadata; not fetched live
evidence_columns.status_at_collection: Original pipeline status, not current status or proof of recovery
evidence_columns.confirmed_categories: Sorted semicolon-separated confirmed classes; a pipeline may have more than one
evidence_columns.confirmed_failed_job_ids: Sorted semicolon-separated IDs of only the confirmed infrastructure-failed attempts, not every failed job
evidence_columns.confirmed_first_attempt_job_ids: Confirmed jobs with retained attempt_index == 0 per pipeline + expanded job name/stage, not first pipeline per commit
evidence_columns.confirmed_later_attempt_job_ids: Confirmed jobs with retained attempt_index > 0; disjoint from first-attempt IDs
evidence_columns.any_attempt_confirmed: True for every included pipeline; this any-attempt rule defines the headline numerator
evidence_columns.first_attempt_confirmed: Whether any confirmed job had attempt_index == 0; does not change inclusion

retention.limitation: Bulk raw logs and API snapshots were deleted under authorized retention; derived evidence remains. This is not a fresh full raw-trace audit.

executive_summary_word_count_scope: Prose only; excludes title, date, table labels and download links
